_comment: Fixture start (near_evolution: warrior 10, sword_skill_used 11 -- one short of min_uses 12) + ORGANIC finish via the repeatable floodplains encounter (goblin_encounter_1, respawns:true, content flag). Re-path: both goblin encounters live on the floodplains and goblin_encounter_2/goblin_encounter_1's ally_requires{met_relc:1} gate means Relc must be met (12,13) before the FIRST fight (fight1, goblin_encounter_2 via goblin_parley's default 'Draw steel' option) so his combat participation is consistent across this script's three fights. goblin_encounter_1 (no conversation gate, repeatable) is the organic-uses fight proper (fight2 here, fight3 after the sleep/evolve beat). The fixture itself deliberately does not evolve on its own -- the organic win is what actually crosses the evolution gate.

steps._comment: Meet Relc (12,13) before any ally_requires-gated fight.
SOCIAL PILLAR II PHASE C: first talk to Relc this waking now absorbs the rotating pool line (dialogue_line + chatted_with_<id> + heard_gossip banks); a second interact opens the real conversation.

ONBOARDING O2/O5: goblin_encounter_1 RELOCATED to (30,23) and is now PROXIMITY-triggered (trigger_radius 2, no interact). From the gob2 approach cell (28,17) -- gob2 now removed, so column 28 is clear -- step down: (28,20) is Chebyshev 3 (safe), the next step to (28,21) is dist 2 and springs the ambush. This is fight2, the organic repeatable-encounter grind that crosses the evolution's sword-use gate.

Issue #62 finding 8: goblin_encounter_1 is now a ONE-SHOT retirement -- this victory (fight2) is its ONLY win ever, so it IS removed for good here (flipped from the old assert_event_absent, which proved the opposite -- respawns:true dormancy -- before this fix).

Return to the inn from the ambush cell (28,21) -- goblin_encounter_1 (30,23) is gone for good now (one-shot), so re-crossing its zone is trivially safe. up15->(28,6) (gob2 removed, column clear), left21->(7,6), up+interact -> floodplains_inn_door.
#49: ground-floor alcove bed removed; teleport up to your_bed (the inn's only bed now) since the inn walk isn't this beat's subject.

Issue #79: the sleep veil now names the fork RESULT with flavor -- lines:2 is the bracket proclamation ('[Warrior Class -> Swordsman Class!]') PLUS the new results-only flavor line ('Your hands have chosen the sword.'), structural proof it rendered (no OCR needed).
Teleport back down to (2,3) (the cell the old ground-floor route reached via 'up 3').

fight3 -- issue #62 finding 8: goblin_encounter_1 is now a ONE-SHOT retirement (no more respawns:true), already spent by fight2 above, so it can't re-arm here. Re-pinned onto relc_spar (persistent:true, ALWAYS immediately re-fightable, trivial-flagged so it doesn't touch the accomplishment tally this beat never needed) -- proves the evolved Swordsman kit in a real live fight instead. From the floodplains door (7,6): right5->(12,6), down6->(12,12) (the same Meet-Relc approach fight1 already used), interact -- met_relc is already banked from fight1's own beat, so `meet`'s re-entry hides the fresh-intro option and shows ['What's out here worth guarding?'(0), 'Got time to show me how to fight? (Spar)'(1), 'Keep walking.'(2)]; move down 1 to the Spar option.
First interact this waking (a sleep just happened for the evolution beat) absorbs Relc's rotating pool bark -- a second interact opens the real relc_intro graph.
steps.name: interact

options.text: Got time to show me how to fight? (Spar)

steps._comment: spar_offer node -- base text (sparred_with_relc not yet banked this run). Options ['Ready when you are.'(0), 'Another time.'(1)]; confirm at the default cursor (0) fires start_combat:relc_spar and ends the conversation in the same choose() call.

payload_contains.speaker: Relc
payload_contains.text: Ha! Good instinct. Everyone swings wrong until someone laughs at them. Watch keeps training dummies in the gatehouse; I drag a couple out when gate duty gets slow. Don't ask about the wheels. Rules are simple: you move, you hit, you don't cry.
